'''Charles Barry Osmond''' {{Post-nominals|country=AUS|FAA|FRS}} (born 20 September 1939) is an Australian plant biologist.<ref name=EAS>{{Cite web|url=http://www.eoas.info/biogs/P001443b.htm|title=Osmond, Charles Barry (Barry) (1939 - )|website=Encyclopedia of Australian Science|language=en-gb|access-date=2024-02-16}}</ref>

Barry Osmond was born in [[Cooranbong, New South Wales]] in 1939. He studied at the [[University of New England (Australia)|University of New England]], earning a BSc(Hons) in 1961 and MSc in 1963, followed by a PhD from the [[University of Adelaide]] in 1965. In 1967 he joined the [[Australian National University]] as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow. He was Professor of Environmental Biology 1978–1987, Director, Research School of Biological Sciences 1991-1998 and Professor, Photo Bioenergetics Group 1998–2001.<ref name=EAS />

==Awards==
* Goldacre Medal, Australian Society of Plant Physiologists 1972
* [[Edgeworth David Medal]], [[Royal Society of New South Wales]] 1973
* [[Fellow of the Australian Academy of Science]] 1978
* [[Fellow of the Royal Society]] 1984
* Distinguished Alumni award, University of New England 1994
* [[Clarke Medal]] (Botany), Royal Society of New South Wales 1997
* [[Humboldt Research Award]], (Forschungspreis), [[Alexander von Humboldt Foundation]] 1997
